description: Gets item fields as either names or fields or template fields.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

id.description: The ID of the item to retrieve field information for. Supply this or path.

includeStandardFields.description: Includes fields that are defined on 'Standard template'.

language.description: The language that will be analysed.

name.description: The array of names to include - supports wildcards.

path.description: The path of the item to retrieve field information for. Supply this or id.

returnType.description: Includes fields that are defined on 'Standard template'.

name: common-get-item-field
